messages:
alex: Midday check-in — queue at ~42 tickets, 3 P1s open. Handing off to @maria later. Quick updates below.

triage-bot: Queue depth: 42 | New P1s: 3 | Avg SLA breach risk: low

alex: P1s: (1) Email ingestion failing for some customers — SSO token expiry appears related. (2) Embeddings job failed intermittently — retry path added but needs canary. (3) Billing webhook duplicates creating duplicate invoices.

maria: I'll pick up the email ingestion one. Any recent logs/alerts? see <https://logs.redwood/internal/email-ingest|logs> for traces, but I need a repro.

sam: I pushed a small patch for embeddings retry logic, need a quick code review: https://git.redwood/infra/embeds PR #512 :eyes:

jordan: Oncall, can you schedule a canary rollout for the retry change after review? Prefer low-traffic window 18:00 PST.

alex: Also noticed macro "Escalate - Email Ingest" is inserting wrong playbook link. Can we update macro text to point to new KB? Current macro points to old playbook. Proposed text: "Escalate to SRE — https://kb.redwood/internal/email-ingest"

maria: I can update macros after I triage, but blocker: I don't have the service account key to run a local repro. @jordan can you grant a short-lived key or point me to the runbook?

jordan: I can generate a short-lived key, will DM creds and post an audit note here when done.

sam: PR #512 ready for review: small fix + test. @alex mind a quick approve? snippet: ```diff
+ retryCount++
- timeout = 30
```

alex: Reviewing now. If unit tests pass I'll approve. Also flagged several tickets with label "needs-more-info" — please check before EOD.

triage-bot: Usage note: macro "embeds-retry" used 7x in last 24h, consider deprecating or adding safer defaults.

maria: Plan: update macros — remove old email escalate link, add repro steps, attach KB link, and add "needs-more-info" checklist to the default reply template. Will post before 17:30.

alex: Handoff notes for night shift: focus on P1 email ingest and billing duplicates; if embeddings incidents recur after PR, rollback PR #512. Night oncall is @sam.

sam: Got it. I'll be oncall and monitor dashboards and PagerDuty. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks team. I'll issue the key and schedule the canary in ~10m. :rocket:

alex: If anyone finds a customer repro, drop it into the ticket and ping me — I'll escalate immediately.
